mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.2% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of central bank rate cuts, thereby boosting equity valuations through lower discount rates and positive forward S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average forward return in triggered periods is not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in private demand, which increases the probability of monetary policy accommodation and triggers positive forward S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 1050 and RSAFS < 445000 in same month
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression of 60-day returns on the interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 106.0 in two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which raises recession risks and prompts the Federal Reserve to adopt a dovish stance, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the average forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 450,000 million dollars, combined with rising housing starts (HOUST > 1070), signals strong underlying demand momentum, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 450000 and HOUST > 1070 in same month
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient in a regression is not positive and significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.25% after a period of near-zero rates signals the start of a monetary tightening cycle, which increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 0.25% after 3 consecutive months at or below 0.12%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 50,000 jobs in a month, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%), indicates labor market weakening, which increases the likelihood of policy intervention and triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS < 50000 and UNRATE > 5.0% in same month
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized in the most recent quarter signals a weakening economy, which increases the probability of fiscal or monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
